statement: Square-root-scale path and adaptive-query barrier S.1--S.4. For every prime b and fixed integer A>=4, all sufficiently large N=b^K contain a support-minimal unequal-cardinality equal-product path on 2 floor(K/4)+1 distinct integers wholly inside (N/b^6,N]. Its edge primes lie in (X,2X), X=b^(floor(K/2)-A), so it avoids every prescribed prime below X. For every uniform adaptive exact-valuation decision tree whose terminating all-zero branch omits b and queries only primes below X, either the output is not a transversal or it deletes at least Z(T)-t integers. For a shared-seed randomized mixture, Pr(output is a transversal)<=E|D|/(L-t), where L is the essential infimum of the seedwise zero-transcript populations. If the zero-branch reciprocal prime mass is at most 1-delta, expected o(N) deletion has success probability o(1). The cutoff is optimal up to a fixed factor for this path host, because two incident labels above sqrt(N) already have product greater than N.
closes: fixed-width support-minimal path avoidance to a fixed multiplicative distance below sqrt(N)
deterministic uniform adaptive valuation-query trees at the square-root-scale zero transcript
shared-seed randomized mixtures with an exact density-sensitive success-probability bound
the square-root geometric limitation of the degree-two edge-prime path host
dependency_gaps: The dyadic prime-reservoir step uses the standard prime-number-theorem consequence pi(2X)-pi(X)~X/log X; an independent auditor must source-check this dependency and its asymptotic use.

The decision program must be uniform across inputs after conditioning on one shared seed. Exact-label access, nonuniform per-integer programs, and private per-input query randomness are outside scope.
The all-zero branch must terminate, omit the padding prime, and query only primes below X. Off-zero branches are unrestricted.
The o(N)-cost corollary requires a positive-density zero transcript; the exact L-dependent bound remains valid without that corollary.
No global alteration is excluded, and one displayed witness path can be repaired by one additional deletion.
No full transversal bound, density-one construction, infinite coherence theorem, or solution of Erdos 786 is proved.
Independent reconstruction and external novelty comparison have not been performed.

evidence_classification.evidence_strength: author-verified all-parameter natural proof with a named prime-number-theorem dependency and exact finite replay
evidence_classification.scope: standalone square-root-scale obstruction for uniform adaptive valuation-query classifiers and shared-seed randomized mixtures
